regime_summary.note: Fixture-heavy first-pass; not market-implied odds. Multipolar competition + elevated rates structure.

nodes.title: Advanced semiconductor manufacturing remains geographically concentrated
nodes.fact: Leading-edge logic capacity is highly concentrated in a small number of firms and locations.
nodes.interpretation: Systemic risk node linking geopolitics, AI compute, and capex cycles.

nodes.title: US–China strategic competition remains the primary geopolitical axis
nodes.fact: Export controls on advanced semiconductors and manufacturing equipment remain in force.
nodes.interpretation: Transmits into tech supply chains, capital allocation, and military posture.

nodes.title: Frontier AI remains compute- and energy-constrained
nodes.fact: Leading labs continue multi-billion-dollar training and inference buildouts.
nodes.interpretation: Investable exposure concentrated in semis, power, and platforms.

nodes.title: Global policy rates remain elevated vs 2010s baseline
nodes.fact: Major advanced-economy policy rates are still well above post-GFC low-decade averages.
nodes.interpretation: Higher-for-longer or staggered cuts reprice duration, risk assets, USD, and BTC beta.

nodes.title: Bitcoin remains a high-beta expression of global liquidity and risk appetite
nodes.fact: Spot BTC ETFs and corporate treasury narratives expanded institutional access channels.
nodes.interpretation: Watch real rates, USD liquidity, ETF flows, regulatory clarity as first-order drivers.

edges.note: export controls and dual-use policy bind leading-edge capacity geography
concentrated fabs/packaging gate AI scale-out cost and location
real rates and USD liquidity path set high-beta risk appetite
AI/power capex cycle coexists with risk-on liquidity beta — not the same driver
